title: StrategyArtifact
$comment: Compile -> store. The persisted bundle: compiled runnable + its schema.

artifact_ref.description: URI to the compiled runnable module in the artifact store.

layout_hash.description: Copied from the embedded schema for indexability. DISTINCT from checksum: checksum answers 'are these the artifact's exact bytes' (integrity); layout_hash answers 'does this code's memory contract match what the runtime will deliver' (compatibility). An intact artifact can still be layout-stale -- that second failure is the silent one.
